```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Overview
This analysis investigates the correlation between MAVE flow-seq scores and predicted residue conservation scores generated by ConSurf

```{r packages}
library(writexl)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
```

# Load raw data

```{r load-data}
MasterFile_Input <- readxl::read_excel("Supplementary Table 2_MAVE Master File.xlsx")
```

# Preparing Data

Filter MAVE flow-seq scores with >= 3 barcodes

```{r data preparation}
MAVE_Consurf_df <- MasterFile_Input %>%
  mutate(
    Residue = paste0(WT_AA, Position)) %>%
  filter(MAVE_Barcode_Count >2) 

Consurf_Score_Summary <- MAVE_Consurf_df %>%
  mutate(MAVE_Score = as.numeric(MAVE_Score)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(MAVE_Score)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Consurf_Score)) %>%
  group_by(Consurf_Score) %>%
  summarise(
    number = n(),
    Mean_score = mean(MAVE_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min_score = min(MAVE_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_score = max(MAVE_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```  

# Calculating the median MAVE flow-seq score at each position

```{r position levle analysis}
Position_Level_df <- MAVE_Consurf_df %>%
  mutate(
    MAVE_Score = as.numeric(MAVE_Score),
    Consurf_group = as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", Consurf_Score))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(MAVE_Score),
    !is.na(Consurf_group)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Position, Consurf_group) %>%
  summarise(
    median_MAVE = median(MAVE_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_MAVE = sd(MAVE_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_variants = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Number of positions contributing to each ConSurf score
n_labels_pos <- Position_Level_df %>%
  group_by(Consurf_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    y_pos = 0.27
  )
```

# Calculating the Correlation between Flow-Seq Score and ConSurf Score 

```{r correlation analysis}

#Spearman rank analysis
Position_Level_spearman <- cor.test(
  Position_Level_df$Consurf_group,
  Position_Level_df$median_MAVE,
  method = "spearman",
  exact = FALSE
)
# Pearson analysis
Position_Level_pearson <- cor.test(
  Position_Level_df$Consurf_group,
  Position_Level_df$median_MAVE,
  method = "pearson"
)

# Results table
Position_Level_results_table <- data.frame(
  
  Method = c(
    "Spearman correlation",
    "Pearson correlation"),
  
  Effect_estimate = c(
    unname(Position_Level_spearman$estimate),
    unname(Position_Level_pearson$estimate)),
  
  P_value = c(
    Position_Level_spearman$p.value,
    Position_Level_pearson$p.value),
  
  Interpretation = c(
    "Monotonic association (rank-based)",
    "Linear correlation")
)

```

# Plotting the MAVE Flow-Seq Score Level Against ConSurf Score 
```{r plotting position level analysis}
consurf_cbs_palette <- c(
  "1" = "#238443",
  "2" = "#78C679",
  "3" = "#D9F0A3",
  "4" = "#FEE8C8",
  "5" = "#FDBB84",
  "6" = "#FC8D59",
  "7" = "#E34A33",
  "8" = "#B30000",
  "9" = "#7F0000"
)


Position_Level_Consurf_BoxPlot <- ggplot(
  Position_Level_df,
  aes(
    x = Consurf_group,
    y = median_MAVE,
    fill = factor(Consurf_group)
  )
) +
  
  # Boxplots
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.8,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.15,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  
  # Individual residue positions
  geom_quasirandom(
    width = 0.32,
    size = 0.65,
    alpha = 0.6,
    stroke = 0.1
  ) +
  
  # ConSurf colours
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = consurf_cbs_palette
  ) +
  
  # Number of positions
  geom_text(
    data = n_labels_pos,
    aes(
      x = Consurf_group,
      y = y_pos,
      label = paste0("N=", n)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2
  ) +
  
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = -0.9,
    label = paste0(
      "Spearman \u03C1 = ",
      round(unname(Position_Level_spearman$estimate), 2)
    ),
    size = 2,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = -0.95,
    label = paste0(
      "Pearson r = ",
      round(unname(Position_Level_pearson$estimate), 2)
    ),
    size = 2,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  
    # Neutral reference
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    colour = "darkgreen",
    linewidth = 0.15,
    linetype = "dashed",
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  
  # Y-axis
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-1, 0.35),
    breaks = seq(-1, 0.25, by = 0.25),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  
  # X-axis
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:9,
    labels = 1:9
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "ConSurf Score",
    y = "Residue Median Flow-Seq Score"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent",colour = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line( colour = "gray90",linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "gray90",  linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7,face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7,face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks = element_line( colour = "black",  linewidth = 0.1),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# Display plot
print(Position_Level_Consurf_BoxPlot)

ggsave(
  "Position_Level_Consurf_BoxPlot.pdf",
  plot = Position_Level_Consurf_BoxPlot,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 80,
  height = 65,
  units = "mm")

```

# Statistical Analysis for Position Level Analysis
```{r stats for position level analysis}
kw_position <- kruskal.test(
  median_MAVE ~ factor(Consurf_group),
  data = Position_Level_df
)


#Dunn's post-hoc test
Position_level_stats <- Position_Level_df %>%
  mutate(
    Consurf_group = factor(Consurf_group)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(median_MAVE),
    !is.na(Consurf_group)
  ) %>%
  dunn_test(
    median_MAVE ~ Consurf_group,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  )

```
